title: Add live verify drift fixture coverage
summary: Add an opt-in live test that induces intentional state drift and asserts `covenant verify --json` emits one stable JSON report, includes actionable drift repair hints, and exits non-zero when orphans exist.
expectedFailureModes: Verify drift output stays human-only, forcing automation to scrape text or ignore failures.
`verify --json` prints partial JSON while also emitting stderr or extra stdout lines, making it non-machine-readable.
The verifier detects drift but returns exit 0, allowing corrupted state to silently pass.
The live drift fixture mutates global state instead of a temp home, contaminating other tests.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd --test live_cli_verify_json --locked -- --ignored live_
nextAction: Triaged task: extend live_cli_verify_json to induce drift and assert verify --json exits non-zero with actionable drift repair fields.
